import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_36/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_36/test_1.csv"
    ]

    # Define the target schema column order and types
    target_columns = [
        'tripduration', 'starttime', 'stoptime', 'start station id', 'start station name',
        'start station latitude', 'start station longitude', 'end station id', 'end station name',
        'end station latitude', 'end station longitude', 'bikeid', 'usertype', 'birth year', 'gender'
    ]

    # List to hold dataframes from each source
    dfs = []

    for file_path in source_files:
        # Read each source CSV
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

        # Ensure columns are in the correct order and all present
        df = df[target_columns]

        # Enforce data types according to target schema
        df = df.astype({
            'tripduration': 'int64',
            'starttime': 'string',
            'stoptime': 'string',
            'start station id': 'int64',
            'start station name': 'string',
            'start station latitude': 'float64',
            'start station longitude': 'float64',
            'end station id': 'int64',
            'end station name': 'string',
            'end station latitude': 'float64',
            'end station longitude': 'float64',
            'bikeid': 'int64',
            'usertype': 'string',
            'birth year': 'int64',
            'gender': 'int64'
        })

        dfs.append(df)

    # Concatenate all source dataframes into one target dataframe
    target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Write the combined dataframe to the target CSV file
    target_df.to_csv(
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_36/target_multisource_cot.csv",
        index=False
    )

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
